notes: Pre-run 15:28: sole MCP client, single tab already authenticated. GET /geo/api/v1/auth/me -> 200, language "en-GB", org_name QA-GEO. No organisation switch.

Each language Save was done with no guard; the guard (context.route **/geo/api/**: GET + POST /reports/{id}/export/(pptx|xlsx|pdf) only, everything else aborted) was installed right after each switch; unrouteAll() before each later change and at the end. No other write request was sent.

results.title: TC-GEO-1269-003 - PowerPoint and PDF exports in French show the polarity labels in French

steps.title: Given the user is on the Overview of brand analysis B
steps.observed: Toyota 439acd96 (B), interface language fr-FR (saved setting, /auth/me language=fr-FR), Overview, filters 28 sept. 2026 – 4 oct. 2026, Tous les pays (États-Unis, France, Espagne all ticked), Moteurs IA 4 = ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity (Claude off/disabled). steps.title: When the user exports the analysis as PowerPoint in French

File downloaded: exports/FR_Toyota_AI_Visibility_Report.pptx (24 slides, title slide "Rapport de visibilité IA").

steps.title: Then each concept row shows the polarity label and the word "sources" in French
steps.expected: The positive, mixed and negative labels and "sources" are the French strings of the strings sheet; no English "Positive", "Mixed", "Negative" left
steps.observed: Slide 4 "Les concepts qui façonnent votre image" / "Top 10 concepts par fréquence": Fiabilité "23 sources • Positif" 14%, Efficacité énergétique "29 sources • Positif" 14%, Leadership hybride "17 sources • Positif" 8%, Usage urbain "19 sources • Positif" 4%, Coûts d'entretien "10 sources • Positif" 3%, Coût d'achat "8 sources • Mitigé" 3%, Bruit à l'accélération "7 sources • Négatif" 3%. Strings sheet: dashboard.concepts.positive/mixed/negative = Positif / Mitigé / Négatif, dashboard.signals.sources_other = "{{count}} sources" -> all match. 0 English "Positive"/"Mixed"/"Negative" on the concept slides (the only "Positive" in the deck is French data text on slide 2: "Forte Image Client Positive").

steps.title: And no numeric sentiment score and no barometer are shown
steps.expected: No "+80 sentiment" / "-80 sentiment" text, no -100 to +100 value and no gauge on any key concepts slide
steps.observed: Concept slides 4, 17, 22: 0 "sentiment" text, 0 signed -100..+100 value, 0 picture, 0 chart, 0 arc/gauge shape.

steps.title: When the user exports the analysis as PDF in French
steps.expected: The key concepts pages show the same French labels as the PowerPoint, with no score and no gauge
steps.observed: POST …/export/pdf?…&lang=fr-FR -> exports/FR_Toyota_AI_Visibility_Report.pdf (24 pages, no text layer: 0 text items). Pages 4 and 17 rendered with pdf.js and read: same 7 concepts, same order and %, labels "Positif" / "Mitigé" / "Négatif" and "{n} sources" as the PPTX; no score, no gauge.

results.notes: Side observation (not a GEO-1269 criterion; no strings-sheet reference for this export string): the distribution bar of slides/pages 4 and 17 reads "Mitigé · 1 sujets" / "Négatif · 1 sujets" (plural used with 1; the dashboard says "1 thème", strings sheet dashboard.concepts.topic_one = "{{count}} thème"). Same pattern as the EN deck ("1 topics").

results.title: TC-GEO-1269-007 - XLSX export in French shows the polarity labels in French with no Score column
results.error: Expected: the Sentiment column of the concepts tables holds the French strings of the strings sheet (Positif / Mitigé / Négatif). Observed: the Mixed concept Coût d'achat shows "Mixte" (Vue d’ensemble!B42, Voitures hybrides!B14). Positif / Négatif are correct; no English label, no Score column.
